concepts.name: 留数定理
concepts.formal: 由留数定理，有 $$2 \pi \mathrm{iRes} [ f (z), \mathrm{i} ] = \int_ {[ - R, r)} f (z) \mathrm{d} z + \int_ {C _ {r}} f (z) \mathrm{d} z + \int_ {r} ^ {R} \frac {\ln x}{(x ^ {2} + 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {C _ {R}} f (z) \mathrm{d} z.\tag{6.14}$$

concepts.name: 计算极点的留数公式
concepts.formal: $$\operatorname{Res} [ f (z), i ] = \lim _ {z \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z} [ f (z) (z - i) ^ {2} ] = \left. \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z} \frac {\ln z}{(z + i) ^ {2}} \right| _ {z = i} = \left[ \frac {1}{z} \frac {1}{(z + i) ^ {2}} - \frac {2}{(z + i) ^ {3}} \ln z \right] _ {z = i} = - \frac {1}{4 i} + \frac {2}{8 i} \ln i.$$
concepts.source_quote: 依计算极点的留数公式，有

concepts.name: 公式(6.17)
concepts.formal: $$\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {p} R (x) d x = \frac {2 \pi i}{1 - e ^ {2 p \pi i}} \sum \operatorname{Res} z ^ {p} R (z).\tag{6.17}$$
concepts.source_quote: 在(6.16)式两边令 $r\to0,R\to+\infty$ ，取极限得 $$\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {p} R (x) d x = \frac {2 \pi i}{1 - e ^ {2 p \pi i}} \sum \operatorname{Res} z ^ {p} R (z).\tag{6.17}$$
